prompt: Explain inflation using only tailgating metaphors. Do not stop when the metaphors break down.
response: Last season your burger cost you one cooler of beer. This year that same burger's two coolers, and the beer went up on you too. Everybody in the lot decided to upgrade their grill the exact same weekend, so now the charcoal's gone and the prices went right up the smokestack with it. The Fed's the fella walkin' the rows tellin' everybody quit lightin' more coals, we got plenty fire already. Keep it up and pretty soon you're haulin' a whole wheelbarrow of brats just to trade for one bun. Same tailgate, buddy — takes twice the truck to feed it.
